This document adapts the original code by Bailey et al. to fit models with intensive longitudinal data (ILD) with 30 waves of data. Large parts of the code will be the same, with the main changes occurring in the model specifications.

### Init

```{r}
## random seed and packages 
set.seed(427)

library(mvtnorm)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape)
library(gridExtra)
library(lavaan)
library(reshape2)

# extra for me
library(tidyverse)

## Function definitions from Bailey
row <- function( M ){
    if( ! ( is.matrix(M) && dim(M)[1] == dim(M)[2] && dim(M)[1]>0 ) ){
        rowM <- NULL
    } else {
        F <- dim(M)[1]
        rowM <- matrix( NA, nrow=F^2, ncol=1)
        for ( r in (1:F) ) {
            for( c in (1:F) ) {
                rowM[ c+F*(r-1), 1 ] <- M[r,c]
            }
        }
    }
    return( rowM )
}
irow <- function( rowM ){
    if( ! ( !is.null(rowM) && ( is.matrix(rowM) || (is.array(rowM) && length( which( dim(rowM) > 1 ) ) == 1) ) && dim(rowM)[1]>0 && dim(rowM)[2]==1 ) ){
        M <- NULL
    } else {
        F <- sqrt( length( rowM ) )
        M <- matrix( NA, nrow=F, ncol=F )
        for ( r in (1:F) ) {
            for ( c in (1:F) ) {
                M[r,c] <- rowM[ c+F*(r-1) ]
            }
        }
    }
    return( M )
}
```

### Simulations

#### Auto-correlative effects

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

conditions_autocorr <- c(.05,.1,.15,.2,.25,.3,.35,.4)
timepoints <- 15 # just to check if it runs, run again with 90
filename_prefix <- "small_timepoints_autocorr_sim"
data_struct <- create_metadata()

# N participants
for (a in seq(1:length(conditions_autocorr))){
  cat("Starting simulation for condition ", a, "\n")
  
  data <- DGM(autocorr_effects = conditions_autocorr[a], timepoints = timepoints)
  
  # Initialize storage for this N condition
  condition_results <- data.frame(
    autocorr = integer(),
    timepoints_used = integer(),
    iteration = integer(),
    varRIx = numeric(),
    varRIy = numeric(),
    convergence = logical(),
    fit_measures = I(list()),  # list column
    coefficients = I(list()),  
    processing_time = numeric()
  )
  
  for (i in seq(3,timepoints,1)){ # steps of 1 for smaller sim of lower values
    start_time <- Sys.time()  
    
    modelSpec <- generate_riclpm(i)
    
    fit <- sem(model = modelSpec, data = data$data)
    
    converged <- lavInspect(fit, "converged")
    fit_measures <- fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli",
                                       "rmsea", "srmr"))
    
    coeff <- if(converged) {coef(fit)} else {NULL}  
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
        autocorr = conditions_autocorr[a],  
        timepoints_used = i,
        iteration = i/3,
        varRIx = if(converged) coef(fit)["varRIx"] else NA,
        varRIy = if(converged) coef(fit)["varRIy"] else NA,
        convergence = converged,
        fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures)),
        coefficients = I(list(coeff)),
        processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, 
                                              units = "secs"))
      ))
    
    rm(fit)
  }
  
  data_struct$results <- rbind(data_struct$results, condition_results)
  
  filename <- save_clear(data_struct, filename_prefix)
  
  cat("Completed Sim no. ", a, "\n")
  
  rm(data)
  gc()
}
```

### Sequence visualisation

Check stationarity for more confounders , max eigenvalue is still under 1 for 7 confounders on x and y. Data generating mechanism function has a warning message built in that warns if the max eigenvalue \> 1, and / or sigma is not positive semidefinite. Let's also do a visual check of some sequences.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

df <- DGM(n_x_confounders = 7, n_y_confounders = 7, 
          autocorr_effects = .1,
          timepoints = 2000)

plot_xy_sequences(df$data, 
                  timepoints = df$parameters$timepoints, n_participants = 3)

df <- DGM(n_x_confounders = 7, n_y_confounders = 7, 
          autocorr_effects = .2,
          timepoints = 2000)

plot_xy_sequences(df$data, 
                  timepoints = df$parameters$timepoints, n_participants = 3)

df <- DGM(n_x_confounders = 7, n_y_confounders = 7, 
          autocorr_effects = .3,
          timepoints = 2000)

plot_xy_sequences(df$data, 
                  timepoints = df$parameters$timepoints, n_participants = 3)
```

The more confounders, and the stronger the autocorrelation effects are, the smaller the frequency of the fluctuations around the mean become.

### Analytical Formulation for variance

We are in luck! The DGM function provided by Bailey already uses the covariance matrix of the observed formula's. I've added it to the returned parameters under StatCOVmatrix.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

test <- DGM(autocorr_effects = .3, timepoints = 3)

Sigma <- as.data.frame(test$parameters$StatCOVmatrix)
Sigma[2,2]
Sigma[1,1]
```

Allowing us to extract the variance of X and Y, along with other variables. This is great, now let's use it to plot the proportion. I added another plotting function to the source file which accomplishes this.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

data <- larger_corrected_autocorr_sim_20250914_125635$results

# Basic usage - only autocorr varies, timepoints fixed at 3 for population variance
plot <- plot_varRIx_proportion_auto(
  data = data, 
  x_var = "timepoints_used",        
  group_var = "autocorr",             
  x_label = "Time Points Used", 
  group_label = "Autocorrelation", 
  plot_title = "Random Intercept Variance as Proportion of Total X Variance",
  ylim = c(0,1)
)
print(plot)
```

### MRI-CLPM

Get model specification for the new model (update function, check identification)

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

data <- DGM(timepoints = 30, autocorr_effects = .2)

fitToep <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(30,2,"toeplitz"), data$data)
fitFree <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(30,2,"free"), data$data)
fitRICLPM <- sem(generate_riclpm(30), data$data)

view(lavInspect(fitToep, "cov.lv"))

summary(fitRICLPM)     # ax:.253 ay:.254 (SE .001)
summary(fitToep)       # ax:.215 ay:.211 (SE .001-,002)
summary(fitFreeMRICLPM)# ax:.204 ay:.208 (SE .002)
```

Let's set up a simulation analysing the bias over time when using a normal RI-CLPM versus the new MRI-CLPM (or segmented RI-CLPM (SRI-CLPM)?). So two lines over time, with conditions set to vary the autoregressive effects (.1,.2,.3). Minimum timepoints analysed 12, increasing in steps of 4, with a timespan of RI's of 4 and a maximum of 80.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

# Simulation parameters
autocorr_levels <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
timepoints_seq <- seq(12, 80, by = 4)
timespan_ri <- 4
filename_prefix <- "riclpm_vs_mriclpm_bias"

# Create metadata structure
data_struct <- create_metadata()

# True parameter values from DGM (default beta_focal = 0.1)
true_bx <- 0.1
true_by <- 0.1

# Loop over autocorrelation levels
for (a in seq_along(autocorr_levels)) {
  cat("Starting simulation for autocorr = ", autocorr_levels[a], "\n")
  
  # Generate data with current autocorrelation level
  data <- DGM(N = 20000, 
              autocorr_effects = autocorr_levels[a],
              timepoints = max(timepoints_seq))
  
  # Initialize storage for this autocorr condition
  condition_results <- data.frame(
    autocorr = numeric(),
    timepoints_used = integer(),
    model_type = character(),  
    varRIx = numeric(),
    varRIy = numeric(),
    convergence = logical(),
    fit_measures = I(list()),
    coefficients = I(list()),
    processing_time = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop over timepoints
  for (i in timepoints_seq) {
    cat("  Analyzing ", i, " timepoints...\n")
    
    # --- FIT STANDARD RI-CLPM ---
    start_time_riclpm <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_riclpm <- generate_riclpm(i)
    
    fit_riclpm <- sem(model = modelSpec_riclpm, data = data$data)
    
    converged_riclpm <- lavInspect(fit_riclpm, "converged")
    fit_measures_riclpm <- fitMeasures(fit_riclpm, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", 
                                                      "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_riclpm <- if(converged_riclpm) {coef(fit_riclpm)} else {NULL}
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      autocorr = autocorr_levels[a],
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "RI-CLPM",
      varRIx = if(converged_riclpm) coef(fit_riclpm)["varRIx"] else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_riclpm) coef(fit_riclpm)["varRIy"] else NA,
      convergence = converged_riclpm,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_riclpm)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_riclpm)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_riclpm, 
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_riclpm)
    
    # --- FIT MRI-CLPM (Segmented RI-CLPM with Equal Covariances) ---
    start_time_mriclpm_equal <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_mriclpm_equal <- generate_segmented_riclpm(i, timespan = timespan_ri,
                                                          across_seg_cov = "equal")
    
    fit_mriclpm_equal <- sem(model = modelSpec_mriclpm_equal, data = data$data)
    
    converged_mriclpm_equal <- lavInspect(fit_mriclpm_equal, "converged")
    fit_measures_mriclpm_equal <- fitMeasures(fit_mriclpm_equal, 
                                              c("chisq", "df", "pvalue",
                                                "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_mriclpm_equal <- if(converged_mriclpm_equal)
                             {coef(fit_mriclpm_equal)} else {NULL}
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      autocorr = autocorr_levels[a],
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "MRI-CLPM-Equal",
      varRIx = if(converged_mriclpm_equal) {
        # For MRI-CLPM, sum variances across segments
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIx[0-9]+$", names(coef(fit_mriclpm_equal)), 
                        value = TRUE)
        sum(coef(fit_mriclpm_equal)[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_mriclpm_equal) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIy[0-9]+$", names(coef(fit_mriclpm_equal)), 
                        value = TRUE)
        sum(coef(fit_mriclpm_equal)[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      convergence = converged_mriclpm_equal,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_mriclpm_equal)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_mriclpm_equal)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_mriclpm_equal,
                                            units = "secs")),
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_mriclpm_equal)
    
    # --- FIT MRI-CLPM (Segmented RI-CLPM with Zero Covariances) ---
    start_time_mriclpm_zero <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_mriclpm_zero <- generate_segmented_riclpm(i, timespan = timespan_ri, 
                                                         across_seg_cov = "zero")
    
    fit_mriclpm_zero <- sem(model = modelSpec_mriclpm_zero, data = data$data)
    
    converged_mriclpm_zero <- lavInspect(fit_mriclpm_zero, "converged")
    fit_measures_mriclpm_zero <- fitMeasures(fit_mriclpm_zero, 
                                             c("chisq", "df", "pvalue",
                                               "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_mriclpm_zero <- if(converged_mriclpm_zero)
      {coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)}else{NULL}
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      autocorr = autocorr_levels[a],
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "MRI-CLPM-Zero",
      varRIx = if(converged_mriclpm_zero) {
        # For MRI-CLPM, sum variances across segments
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIx[0-9]+$", names(coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)), 
                        value = TRUE)
        sum(coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_mriclpm_zero) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIy[0-9]+$", names(coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)), 
                        value = TRUE)
        sum(coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      convergence = converged_mriclpm_zero,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_mriclpm_zero)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_mriclpm_zero)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_mriclpm_zero,
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_mriclpm_zero)
    gc()
  }
  
  # Add condition results to main data structure
  data_struct$results <- rbind(data_struct$results, condition_results)
  
  # Save and clear memory after each autocorr condition
  filename <- save_clear(data_struct, filename_prefix)
  
  cat("Completed simulation for autocorr = ", autocorr_levels[a], "\n\n")
  
  rm(data, condition_results)
  gc()
}

cat("All simulations completed!\n")
```

```{r}
         plot = bias_plots$by_plot, width = 10, height = 6)
}

cat("Plots saved successfully!\n")
```

#### Timespan

Explorative simulation for the choice of timespan length, along with verifying the desirable unbiased properties of the model.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

# Simulation parameters
autocorr_level <- 0.2  # Fix at one level for simplicity
timespan_values <- c(4, 8, 12)
max_timepoints <- 60
min_timepoints <- 10
filename_prefix <- "timespan_exploration_free"

# Create metadata structure
data_struct <- create_metadata()

# True parameter values from DGM
true_bx <- 0.1
true_by <- 0.1

cat("Starting timespan exploration simulation (Free Covariances)\n")

# Generate data once with maximum timepoints
data <- DGM(N = 20000, 
            autocorr_effects = autocorr_level,
            timepoints = max_timepoints)

# Initialize storage
condition_results <- data.frame(
  timespan = integer(),
  timepoints_used = integer(),
  model_type = character(),  
  varRIx = numeric(),
  varRIy = numeric(),
  bx = numeric(),
  by = numeric(),
  bias_bx = numeric(),
  bias_by = numeric(),
  convergence = logical(),
  fit_measures = I(list()),
  coefficients = I(list()),
  processing_time = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop over timespan values
for (ts in timespan_values) {
  cat("\n--- Timespan = ", ts, " ---\n")
  
  # Generate sequence of timepoints that are multiples of this timespan
  # between min_timepoints and max_timepoints
  timepoints_seq <- seq(ts, max_timepoints, by = ts)
  timepoints_seq <- timepoints_seq[timepoints_seq >= min_timepoints]
  
  cat("Timepoints to analyze:", paste(timepoints_seq, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Loop over timepoints
  for (i in timepoints_seq) {
    cat("  Analyzing ", i, " timepoints with timespan ", ts, "...\n")
    
    # --- FIT STANDARD RI-CLPM (for comparison) ---
    start_time_riclpm <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_riclpm <- generate_riclpm(i)
    fit_riclpm <- sem(model = modelSpec_riclpm, data = data$data,
                      estimator = "MLR",
                      optim.method = "nlminb",
                      control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000))
    
    converged_riclpm <- lavInspect(fit_riclpm, "converged")
    fit_measures_riclpm <- fitMeasures(fit_riclpm, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", 
                                                      "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_riclpm <- if(converged_riclpm) {coef(fit_riclpm)} else {NULL}
    
    bx_riclpm <- if(converged_riclpm && "bx" %in% names(coeff_riclpm)) coeff_riclpm["bx"] else NA
    by_riclpm <- if(converged_riclpm && "by" %in% names(coeff_riclpm)) coeff_riclpm["by"] else NA
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      timespan = NA,  # Standard RI-CLPM doesn't have timespan
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "RI-CLPM",
      varRIx = if(converged_riclpm) coeff_riclpm["varRIx"] else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_riclpm) coeff_riclpm["varRIy"] else NA,
      bx = bx_riclpm,
      by = by_riclpm,
      bias_bx = bx_riclpm - true_bx,
      bias_by = by_riclpm - true_by,
      convergence = converged_riclpm,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_riclpm)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_riclpm)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_riclpm, 
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_riclpm)
    
    # --- FIT MRI-CLPM with Free Covariances ---
    start_time_mriclpm_free <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_mriclpm_free <- generate_segmented_riclpm(i, timespan = ts, 
                                                         across_seg_cov = "free")
    fit_mriclpm_free <- sem(model = modelSpec_mriclpm_free, data = data$data,
                            estimator = "MLR",
                            optim.method = "nlminb",
                            control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000))
    
    converged_mriclpm_free <- lavInspect(fit_mriclpm_free, "converged")
    fit_measures_mriclpm_free <- fitMeasures(fit_mriclpm_free, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue",
                                                                  "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_mriclpm_free <- if(converged_mriclpm_free) {coef(fit_mriclpm_free)} else {NULL}
    
    bx_free <- if(converged_mriclpm_free && "bx" %in% names(coeff_mriclpm_free)) coeff_mriclpm_free["bx"] else NA
    by_free <- if(converged_mriclpm_free && "by" %in% names(coeff_mriclpm_free)) coeff_mriclpm_free["by"] else NA
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      timespan = ts,
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "MRI-CLPM-Free",
      varRIx = if(converged_mriclpm_free) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIx[0-9]+$", names(coeff_mriclpm_free), value = TRUE)
        sum(coeff_mriclpm_free[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_mriclpm_free) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIy[0-9]+$", names(coeff_mriclpm_free), value = TRUE)
        sum(coeff_mriclpm_free[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      bx = bx_free,
      by = by_free,
      bias_bx = bx_free - true_bx,
      bias_by = by_free - true_by,
      convergence = converged_mriclpm_free,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_mriclpm_free)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_mriclpm_free)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_mriclpm_free,
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_mriclpm_free)
    
    # --- FIT MRI-CLPM with Zero Covariances ---
    start_time_mriclpm_zero <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec_mriclpm_zero <- generate_segmented_riclpm(i, timespan = ts, 
                                                         across_seg_cov = "zero")
    fit_mriclpm_zero <- sem(model = modelSpec_mriclpm_zero, data = data$data,
                            estimator = "MLR",
                            optim.method = "nlminb",
                            control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000))
    
    converged_mriclpm_zero <- lavInspect(fit_mriclpm_zero, "converged")
    fit_measures_mriclpm_zero <- fitMeasures(fit_mriclpm_zero, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue",
                                                                  "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
    coeff_mriclpm_zero <- if(converged_mriclpm_zero) {coef(fit_mriclpm_zero)} else {NULL}
    
    bx_zero <- if(converged_mriclpm_zero && "bx" %in% names(coeff_mriclpm_zero)) coeff_mriclpm_zero["bx"] else NA
    by_zero <- if(converged_mriclpm_zero && "by" %in% names(coeff_mriclpm_zero)) coeff_mriclpm_zero["by"] else NA
    
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      timespan = ts,
      timepoints_used = i,
      model_type = "MRI-CLPM-Zero",
      varRIx = if(converged_mriclpm_zero) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIx[0-9]+$", names(coeff_mriclpm_zero), value = TRUE)
        sum(coeff_mriclpm_zero[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      varRIy = if(converged_mriclpm_zero) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIy[0-9]+$", names(coeff_mriclpm_zero), value = TRUE)
        sum(coeff_mriclpm_zero[ri_vars])
      } else NA,
      bx = bx_zero,
      by = by_zero,
      bias_bx = bx_zero - true_bx,
      bias_by = by_zero - true_by,
      convergence = converged_mriclpm_zero,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures_mriclpm_zero)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff_mriclpm_zero)),
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time_mriclpm_zero,
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    rm(fit_mriclpm_zero)
    gc()
  }
}

# Add results to main data structure
data_struct$results <- condition_results

# Save results
filename <- save_clear(data_struct, filename_prefix)

cat("\nTimespan exploration simulation completed!\n")
cat("Results saved to:", filename, "\n")
```

#### Smaller timespans

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

# Simulation parameters
autocorr_level <- 0.2  # Fix at one level for simplicity
timespan_values <- c(2, 3, 4)
min_timepoints <- 6  # Start at 6 to ensure all timespans have at least 2 segments
max_timepoints <- 60
filename_prefix <- "mriclpm_free_timespan_comparison"

# Create metadata structure
data_struct <- create_metadata()

# True parameter values from DGM
true_bx <- 0.1
true_by <- 0.1

cat("Starting MRI-CLPM Free simulation with varying timespans\n")

# Generate data once with maximum timepoints
data <- DGM(N = 20000, 
            autocorr_effects = autocorr_level,
            timepoints = max_timepoints)

# Initialize storage
condition_results <- data.frame(
  timespan = integer(),
  timepoints_used = integer(),
  n_segments = integer(),
  model_type = character(),  
  varRIx = numeric(),
  varRIy = numeric(),
  bx = numeric(),
  by = numeric(),
  bias_bx = numeric(),
  bias_by = numeric(),
  convergence = logical(),
  post_check = logical(),
  fit_measures = I(list()),
  coefficients = I(list()),
  processing_time = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop over timespan values
for (ts in timespan_values) {
  cat("\n=== Timespan = ", ts, " ===\n")
  
  # Generate sequence of timepoints that are multiples of this timespan
  timepoints_seq <- seq(ts, max_timepoints, by = ts)
  timepoints_seq <- timepoints_seq[timepoints_seq >= min_timepoints]
  
  cat("Timepoints to analyze:", paste(timepoints_seq, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Number of models to fit:", length(timepoints_seq), "\n")
  
  # Loop over timepoints
  for (i in timepoints_seq) {
    
    # Calculate number of segments for reporting
    n_seg <- ceiling(i / ts)
    
    cat("  Analyzing", i, "timepoints (", n_seg, "segments)...\n")
    
    # --- FIT MRI-CLPM with Free Covariances ---
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    modelSpec <- generate_segmented_riclpm(i, timespan = ts, 
                                           across_seg_cov = "free")
    
    fit <- tryCatch({
      sem(model = modelSpec, data = data$data,
          estimator = "MLR",
          optim.method = "nlminb",
          control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("    ERROR at timepoints =", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      converged <- lavInspect(fit, "converged")
      post_check <- tryCatch({
        lavInspect(fit, "post.check")
      }, error = function(e) {
        FALSE
      })
      
      fit_measures <- tryCatch({
        fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
      }, error = function(e) {
        rep(NA, 7)
      })
      
      coeff <- if(converged) {coef(fit)} else {NULL}
      
      bx_est <- if(converged && "bx" %in% names(coeff)) coeff["bx"] else NA
      by_est <- if(converged && "by" %in% names(coeff)) coeff["by"] else NA
      
      # Sum RI variances across segments
      varRIx_sum <- if(converged) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIx[0-9]+$", names(coeff), value = TRUE)
        if(length(ri_vars) > 0) sum(coeff[ri_vars]) else NA
      } else NA
      
      varRIy_sum <- if(converged) {
        ri_vars <- grep("^varRIy[0-9]+$", names(coeff), value = TRUE)
        if(length(ri_vars) > 0) sum(coeff[ri_vars]) else NA
      } else NA
      
    } else {
      # Model fitting failed
      converged <- FALSE
      post_check <- FALSE
      fit_measures <- rep(NA, 7)
      coeff <- NULL
      bx_est <- NA
      by_est <- NA
      varRIx_sum <- NA
      varRIy_sum <- NA
    }
    
    # Store results
    condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
      timespan = ts,
      timepoints_used = i,
      n_segments = n_seg,
      model_type = "MRI-CLPM-Free",
      varRIx = varRIx_sum,
      varRIy = varRIy_sum,
      bx = bx_est,
      by = by_est,
      bias_bx = bx_est - true_bx,
      bias_by = by_est - true_by,
      convergence = converged,
      post_check = post_check,
      fit_measures = I(list(fit_measures)),
      coefficients = I(list(coeff)),  # This saves ALL coefficients including RI covariances
      processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, 
                                            units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    # Clean up
    if (!is.null(fit)) rm(fit)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  
  cat("Completed timespan", ts, "\n")
}

# Add results to main data structure
data_struct$results <- condition_results

# Save results
filename <- save_clear(data_struct, filename_prefix)

cat("\n=== MRI-CLPM Free simulation completed! ===\n")
cat("Results saved to:", filename, "\n")
```

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

# Generate data once
max_timepoints <- 42
data <- DGM(N = 20000, timepoints = max_timepoints, autocorr_effects = 0.2)

cat("CLPM, RI-CLPM, SRI-CLPM (Toeplitz), SRI-CLPM (Toeplitz+Cross)\n\n")

# Initialize storage
results <- data.frame(
  timepoints_used = integer(),
  model_type = character(),
  ax = numeric(),
  ay = numeric(),
  bx = numeric(),
  by = numeric(),
  convergence = logical(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Fit models on increasing timepoints
timepoints_seq <- seq(6, max_timepoints, by = 6)

for (tp in timepoints_seq) {
  cat("Fitting models with", tp, "timepoints...\n")
  
  # Subset data
  cols_to_use <- c(paste0("x", 1:tp), paste0("y", 1:tp))
  data_subset <- data$data[, cols_to_use]
  
  # --- CLPM ---
  fit_clpm <- sem(generate_clpm(tp), data = data_subset)
  if (lavInspect(fit_clpm, "converged")) {
    coef_clpm <- coef(fit_clpm)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      timepoints_used = tp,
      model_type = "CLPM",
      ax = coef_clpm["ax"],
      ay = coef_clpm["ay"],
      bx = coef_clpm["bx"],
      by = coef_clpm["by"],
      convergence = TRUE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  # --- RI-CLPM ---
  fit_riclpm <- sem(generate_riclpm(tp), data = data_subset)
  if (lavInspect(fit_riclpm, "converged")) {
    coef_riclpm <- coef(fit_riclpm)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      timepoints_used = tp,
      model_type = "RI-CLPM",
      ax = coef_riclpm["ax"],
      ay = coef_riclpm["ay"],
      bx = coef_riclpm["bx"],
      by = coef_riclpm["by"],
      convergence = TRUE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  # --- SRI-CLPM (Toeplitz) ---
  fit_sri_toep <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(tp, timespan = 2, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz"), 
                      data = data_subset)
  if (lavInspect(fit_sri_toep, "converged")) {
    coef_sri_toep <- coef(fit_sri_toep)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      timepoints_used = tp,
      model_type = "SRI-CLPM-Toeplitz",
      ax = coef_sri_toep["ax"],
      ay = coef_sri_toep["ay"],
      bx = coef_sri_toep["bx"],
      by = coef_sri_toep["by"],
      convergence = TRUE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  # --- SRI-CLPM (Toeplitz + Cross) ---
  fit_sri_cross <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(tp, timespan = 2, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz_cross"), 
                       data = data_subset)
  if (lavInspect(fit_sri_cross, "converged")) {
    coef_sri_cross <- coef(fit_sri_cross)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      timepoints_used = tp,
      model_type = "SRI-CLPM-Toeplitz-Cross",
      ax = coef_sri_cross["ax"],
      ay = coef_sri_cross["ay"],
      bx = coef_sri_cross["bx"],
      by = coef_sri_cross["by"],
      convergence = TRUE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

print(results)
```

## The Bias-Variance trade off

Since our method seems to work for large sample sizes the proof of concept is there. What is needed now is to evaluate whether the method is also applicable when smaller (more realistic sample sizes) are considered. Important is to then not only look at whether a model converges or not, but also whether the standard errors are not too large.

Let's first do some exploratory fitting.

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")

samplesize <- 50 # <-----

data <- DGM(N = samplesize, timepoints = 20)

RICLPM <- sem(model = generate_riclpm(20), data = data$data)
FSRICLPM <- sem(model = generate_segmented_riclpm(20, timespan = 2, 
                                                  across_seg_cov = "free"),
                data = data$data)
TSRICLPM <- sem(model = generate_segmented_riclpm(20, timespan = 2, 
                                                  across_seg_cov = "toeplitz"),
                data = data$data)

anova(FSRICLPM, TSRICLPM, RICLPM)

summary(RICLPM)
summary(TSRICLPM)
```

Set up for a more complete analysis

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(tidyverse)
source("functionSource.R")

# --- Simulation Parameters ---
sample_sizes <- c(50, 100, 200)
max_timepoints <- 36
filename_prefix <- "sriclpm_small_sample_se"

# --- Initialization ---
data_struct <- create_metadata()

cat("Starting Small Sample SE Simulation\n")

# --- Simulation Loop ---
for (current_N in sample_sizes) {
  cat("\n--- Starting Simulation for N =", current_N, "---\n")
  
  # 1. Generate one large dataset (max timepoints) per sample size
  #    We subset this dataset for smaller timepoints to ensure consistency across T
  data_gen <- DGM(N = current_N, timepoints = max_timepoints)
  
  # Initialize storage for this condition
  condition_results <- data.frame(
    sample_size = integer(),
    timepoints_used = integer(),
    model_type = character(),
    timespan = integer(),
    convergence = logical(),
    
    # Estimates
    bx = numeric(), by = numeric(), ax = numeric(), ay = numeric(),
    
    # Standard Errors (Specific Request)
    se_bx = numeric(), se_by = numeric(), se_ax = numeric(), se_ay = numeric(),
    
    # Storage
    fit_measures = I(list()),
    coefficients = I(list()),
    processing_time = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2. Iterate through timepoints (4 to 36)
  for (t in 4:max_timepoints) {
    cat(sprintf("  Analyzing T = %d...\n", t))
    
    # Define models to estimate based on valid constraints
    models_to_run <- list()
    
    # A. RI-CLPM (Always estimated)
    models_to_run[[length(models_to_run) + 1]] <- list(
      name = "RI-CLPM", span = NA, 
      syntax = generate_riclpm(t)
    )
    
    # B. SRI-CLPM Models (Only if T is a multiple of timespan)
    # SRI-CLPM-2
    if (t %% 2 == 0) {
      models_to_run[[length(models_to_run) + 1]] <- list(
        name = "SRI-CLPM-2", span = 2, 
        syntax = generate_segmented_riclpm(t, timespan = 2, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz")
      )
    }
    
    # SRI-CLPM-3
    if (t %% 3 == 0) {
      models_to_run[[length(models_to_run) + 1]] <- list(
        name = "SRI-CLPM-3", span = 3, 
        syntax = generate_segmented_riclpm(t, timespan = 3, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz")
      )
    }
    
    # SRI-CLPM-4
    if (t %% 4 == 0) {
      models_to_run[[length(models_to_run) + 1]] <- list(
        name = "SRI-CLPM-4", span = 4, 
        syntax = generate_segmented_riclpm(t, timespan = 4, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz")
      )
    }
    
    # 3. Fit Loop
    for (m in models_to_run) {
      start_time <- Sys.time()
      
      fit <- try(sem(model = m$syntax, data = data_gen$data, 
                     estimator = "MLR", optim.method = "nlminb", 
                     control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000)), 
                 silent = TRUE)
      
      # Default values
      converged <- FALSE
      fit_meas <- NULL
      coefs <- NULL
      est_vals <- list(bx=NA, by=NA, ax=NA, ay=NA)
      se_vals <- list(bx=NA, by=NA, ax=NA, ay=NA)
      
      if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
        converged <- lavInspect(fit, "converged")
        
        if (converged) {
          fit_meas <- fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
          coefs <- coef(fit)
          pe <- parameterEstimates(fit)
          
          # Helper to safely extract Est and SE by label (bx, by, ax, ay)
          for (param in c("bx", "by", "ax", "ay")) {
            row_idx <- which(pe$label == param)
            if (length(row_idx) > 0) {
              est_vals[[param]] <- pe$est[row_idx[1]]
              se_vals[[param]] <- pe$se[row_idx[1]]
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Append results
      condition_results <- rbind(condition_results, data.frame(
        sample_size = current_N,
        timepoints_used = t,
        model_type = m$name,
        timespan = m$span,
        convergence = converged,
        
        bx = est_vals$bx, by = est_vals$by, ax = est_vals$ax, ay = est_vals$ay,
        se_bx = se_vals$bx, se_by = se_vals$by, se_ax = se_vals$ax, se_ay = se_vals$ay,
        
        fit_measures = I(list(fit_meas)),
        coefficients = I(list(coefs)),
        processing_time = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # 4. Save results for this condition
  data_struct$results <- rbind(data_struct$results, condition_results)
  saved_file <- save_clear(data_struct, filename_prefix)
  cat("  Saved progress to:", saved_file, "\n")
}

cat("\nSimulation completed successfully.\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Clean and Aggregate
plot_data <- data_struct$results %>%
  filter(convergence == TRUE) %>% # Only look at converged runs
  group_by(sample_size, timepoints_used, model_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bx = mean(bx, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_bx = mean(se_bx, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bx = median(bx, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_conv = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# 2. Calculate Ratios relative to RI-CLPM
# We pivot wider to align SRI models with the RI-CLPM baseline
se_ratios <- plot_data %>%
  select(sample_size, timepoints_used, model_type, mean_se_bx) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model_type, values_from = mean_se_bx) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate Ratios (Example for SRI-CLPM-2 vs RI-CLPM)
    Ratio_Span2 = `SRI-CLPM-2` / `RI-CLPM`,
    Ratio_Span3 = `SRI-CLPM-3` / `RI-CLPM`,
    Ratio_Span4 = `SRI-CLPM-4` / `RI-CLPM`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Ratio"), names_to = "Comparison", values_to = "SE_Ratio")

ggplot(se_ratios, aes(x = timepoints_used, y = SE_Ratio, color = Comparison)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + # Baseline
  facet_wrap(~sample_size) +
  labs(
    title = "Precision Cost: SE Inflation relative to RI-CLPM",
    subtitle = "Values > 1 indicate SRI-CLPM has larger Standard Errors",
    y = "Ratio (SRI SE / RI SE)",
    x = "Timepoints (T)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(tidyverse)
source("functionSource.R")

# Initialize storage
results <- data.frame(
  seed = integer(),
  model = character(),
  param_variance_bx = numeric(), # This stores SE^2 for bx
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Starting simulation for Parameter Variances...\n")

for (i in 1:100) {
  
  # 1. Generate Data (Safe call)
  data_gen <- try(DGM(N = 100, timepoints = 20, seed = i), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(data_gen, "try-error")) next 
  
  # 2. Fit RI-CLPM
  fit_riclpm <- try(sem(generate_riclpm(T = 20), data = data_gen$data), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (!inherits(fit_riclpm, "try-error")) {
    # Extract the variance of the estimate for 'bx' (SE^2)
    # We use vcov() which returns the covariance matrix of estimates
    cov_mat <- try(vcov(fit_riclpm), silent = TRUE)
    
    if (!inherits(cov_mat, "try-error") && "bx" %in% rownames(cov_mat)) {
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        seed = i,
        model = "RI-CLPM",
        param_variance_bx = cov_mat["bx", "bx"] 
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. Fit SRI-CLPM
  fit_sriclpm <- try(sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(T = 20, timespan = 2, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz"),
                         data = data_gen$data), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (!inherits(fit_sriclpm, "try-error")) {
    cov_mat <- try(vcov(fit_sriclpm), silent = TRUE)
    
    if (!inherits(cov_mat, "try-error") && "bx" %in% rownames(cov_mat)) {
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        seed = i,
        model = "SRI-CLPM",
        param_variance_bx = cov_mat["bx", "bx"]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# --- Plotting ---

# Check if we have data to plot
if (nrow(results) > 0) {
  ggplot(results, aes(x = param_variance_bx, fill = model)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 30, color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Parameter Variance for 'bx'",
      subtitle = "Comparing uncertainty (SE^2) of the cross-lagged effect",
      x = "Variance of Estimate (SE^2)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("RI-CLPM" = "steelblue", "SRI-CLPM" = "firebrick")) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  cat("No models converged successfully.\n")
}
```

### Analysis of the variability in variance estimates

This simulation aims to study how the sample distributions of cross-lagged parameter variances change when the sample size increases. Does the gap between variance estimates of RI-CLPM and SRI-CLPM close? Are they always approximately normally distributed?

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(tidyverse)
source("functionSource.R")

# --- Simulation Configuration ---
# Conditions
sample_sizes <- c(50, 75, 100, 200)
fixed_timepoints <- 24
replications <- 200

# Models to estimate per replication
# List structure: Name, Function call parameters
model_specs <- list(
  list(name = "RI-CLPM", type = "standard", span = NA),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-2", type = "segmented", span = 2),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-3", type = "segmented", span = 3),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-4", type = "segmented", span = 4)
)

filename_prefix <- "sim_N_effect_results"
start_time <- Sys.time()

# --- Initialize Storage ---
# We store results in 'long' format for easier analysis later
results <- data.frame(
  replication = integer(),
  sample_size = integer(),
  model = character(),
  timespan = integer(),
  
  # Outcome: Status
  converged = logical(),
  warning = character(),
  error = character(),
  
  # Outcome: Cross-Lagged Parameters (Estimates)
  est_bx = numeric(),
  est_by = numeric(),
  
  # Outcome: Standard Errors
  se_bx = numeric(),
  se_by = numeric(),
  
  # Outcome: Significance (P-values)
  pval_bx = numeric(),
  pval_by = numeric(),
  
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Starting Simulation: N-Effect (N =", paste(sample_sizes, collapse=","), ")\n")

# --- Main Simulation Loop ---
for (N in sample_sizes) {
  cat(sprintf("\nRunning Condition: N = %d... ", N))
  
  for (i in 1:replications) {
    # Progress dot every 20 reps
    if(i %% 20 == 0) cat(".")
    
    # 1. Generate Data
    # Unique seed per replication/condition combo to ensure reproducibility
    seed_val <- i + (N * 10000)
    
    # Wrap in tryCatch to handle potential generation errors
    data_gen <- tryCatch({
      DGM(N = N, timepoints = fixed_timepoints, seed = seed_val)
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
    
    if (is.null(data_gen)) next # Skip if data gen failed
    
    # 2. Estimate all 4 models on this same dataset
    for (spec in model_specs) {
      
      # Generate Syntax
      if (spec$type == "standard") {
        syntax <- generate_riclpm(T = fixed_timepoints)
      } else {
        syntax <- generate_segmented_riclpm(T = fixed_timepoints, 
                                            timespan = spec$span, 
                                            across_seg_cov = "toeplitz")
      }
      
      # Fit Model
      fit <- try(sem(syntax, data = data_gen$data, 
                     estimator = "MLR", 
                     optim.method = "nlminb",
                     control = list(eval.max = 2000, iter.max = 1000)), 
                 silent = TRUE)
      
      # Initialize row data
      row_res <- list(
        replication = i, sample_size = N, model = spec$name, timespan = spec$span,
        converged = FALSE, warning = NA, error = NA,
        est_bx = NA, est_by = NA, se_bx = NA, se_by = NA, pval_bx = NA, pval_by = NA
      )
      
      # Extract Results if fit was attempted
      if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
        row_res$error <- as.character(attr(fit, "condition"))
      } else {
        # Check Convergence
        row_res$converged <- lavInspect(fit, "converged")
        
        # Check for Warnings (approximated by checking if SEs are finite if converged)
        # Note: accurate warning capture requires calling lavaan differently, 
        # but we can usually deduce issues from results.
        
        if (row_res$converged) {
          # Get Parameter Table
          pe <- parameterEstimates(fit)
          
          # Extract bx (Y -> X)
          bx_row <- pe[pe$label == "bx", ]
          if (nrow(bx_row) > 0) {
            row_res$est_bx <- bx_row$est
            row_res$se_bx  <- bx_row$se
            row_res$pval_bx <- bx_row$pvalue
          }
          
          # Extract by (X -> Y)
          by_row <- pe[pe$label == "by", ]
          if (nrow(by_row) > 0) {
            row_res$est_by <- by_row$est
            row_res$se_by  <- by_row$se
            row_res$pval_by <- by_row$pvalue
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Append to main results
      results <- bind_rows(results, as.data.frame(row_res))
    }
  }
}

# --- Save Final Results ---
saveRDS(results, paste0(filename_prefix, ".rds"))

total_time <- Sys.time() - start_time
cat("\n\nSimulation Finished in:", round(total_time, 2), units(total_time), "\n")
cat("Results saved to", paste0(filename_prefix, ".rds"), "\n")

# --- Quick Diagnostic Check ---
cat("\nConvergence Rates by Condition:\n")
print(table(results$sample_size, results$model, results$converged))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

  filter(converged == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, model) %>%
  summarise(
    Empirical_SE = sd(est_bx, na.rm = TRUE), # sd of the cross-lagged parameter
    Mean_Estimated_SE = mean(se_bx, na.rm = TRUE), # mean of estimated SE's

    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(knitr)

  filter(converged == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Calculate 95% Confidence Intervals
    ci_lower = est_bx - (1.96 * se_bx),
    ci_upper = est_bx + (1.96 * se_bx),
    
    # 2. Check if True Value falls inside the Interval
    covered = (true_value >= ci_lower) & (true_value <= ci_upper)
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Summarize by Condition
```

#### To check the RMSEA, error messages and a different T value

We slightly change the above simulation so it fits our needs all in one. Let's start with T = 12.

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(tidyverse)
library(mvtnorm)
source("functionSource.R")

# --- 1. Simulation Configuration ---
sample_sizes <- c(50, 75, 100, 200)
fixed_timepoints <- 12 
replications <- 200

model_specs <- list(
  list(name = "RI-CLPM", type = "standard", span = NA),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-2", type = "segmented", span = 2),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-3", type = "segmented", span = 3),
  list(name = "SRI-CLPM-4", type = "segmented", span = 4) 
)

filename_prefix <- "sim_T12_warnings_log"

# --- 2. Helper: Smart Fitting Function ---
safe_fit <- function(syntax, data) {
  warn_msgs <- character()
  err_msg <- NA_character_
  fit_obj <- NULL
  
  tryCatch({
    withCallingHandlers({
      fit_obj <- sem(syntax, data = data, 
                     estimator = "MLR", 
                     optim.method = "nlminb",
                     control = list(eval.max = 2500, iter.max = 1500))
    }, warning = function(w) {
      warn_msgs <<- c(warn_msgs, w$message)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
  }, error = function(e) {
    err_msg <<- e$message
  })
  
  return(list(fit = fit_obj, warnings = unique(warn_msgs), error = err_msg))
}

# --- 3. Initialize Storage ---
results <- data.frame(
  replication = integer(),
  sample_size = integer(),
  model = character(),
  converged = logical(),
  error_msg = character(),
  warning_msgs = character(),
  warning_count = integer(),
  rmsea = numeric(),
  est_bx = numeric(), se_bx = numeric(), pval_bx = numeric(),
  est_by = numeric(), se_by = numeric(), pval_by = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Starting Simulation for T = 12 with Warning Logging...\n")

# --- 4. Main Loop ---
for (N in sample_sizes) {
  cat(sprintf("\nProcessing N = %d... ", N))
  
  for (i in 1:replications) {
    if(i %% 20 == 0) cat(".")
    
    seed_val <- i + (N * 10000)
    dgm_out <- tryCatch(DGM(N = N, timepoints = fixed_timepoints, seed = seed_val), 
                        error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if(is.null(dgm_out)) next
    
    for (spec in model_specs) {
      if (spec$type == "standard") {
        syn <- generate_riclpm(T = fixed_timepoints)
      } else {
        syn <- generate_segmented_riclpm(T = fixed_timepoints, 
                                         timespan = spec$span, 
                                         across_seg_cov = "toeplitz")
      }
      
      fit_res <- safe_fit(syn, dgm_out$data)
      
      row_data <- list(
        replication = i, sample_size = N, model = spec$name,
        converged = FALSE, error_msg = NA, warning_msgs = NA, warning_count = 0,
        rmsea = NA,
        est_bx = NA, se_bx = NA, pval_bx = NA,
        est_by = NA, se_by = NA, pval_by = NA
      )
      
      if (!is.na(fit_res$error)) {
        row_data$error_msg <- fit_res$error
      } else {
        if (length(fit_res$warnings) > 0) {
          row_data$warning_count <- length(fit_res$warnings)
          row_data$warning_msgs <- paste(fit_res$warnings, collapse = " | ")
        }
        
        if (!is.null(fit_res$fit)) {
           row_data$converged <- lavInspect(fit_res$fit, "converged")
        }
        
        if (row_data$converged) {
          # FIX 1: Wrap fitMeasures in as.numeric()
          row_data$rmsea <- as.numeric(fitMeasures(fit_res$fit, "rmsea"))
          
          pe <- parameterEstimates(fit_res$fit)
          
          bx_p <- pe[pe$label == "bx", ]
          if(nrow(bx_p) > 0) {
             # FIX 2: Wrap extractions in as.numeric()
             row_data$est_bx <- as.numeric(bx_p$est[1])
             row_data$se_bx <- as.numeric(bx_p$se[1])
             row_data$pval_bx <- as.numeric(bx_p$pvalue[1])
          }
          
          by_p <- pe[pe$label == "by", ]
          if(nrow(by_p) > 0) {
            row_data$est_by <- as.numeric(by_p$est[1])
            row_data$se_by <- as.numeric(by_p$se[1])
            row_data$pval_by <- as.numeric(by_p$pvalue[1])
          }
        }
      }
      results <- bind_rows(results, as.data.frame(row_data))
    }
  }
}

saveRDS(results, paste0(filename_prefix, ".rds"))
cat("\n\nSimulation Finished. Results saved.\n")

# --- Analysis Output ---
cat("\n--- Warning Analysis (Top 10) ---\n")
warning_summary <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(warning_msgs)) %>%
  separate_rows(warning_msgs, sep = " \\| ") %>%
  group_by(sample_size, model, warning_msgs) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(sample_size, model, desc(count))

warning_summary$short_warning <- substr(warning_summary$warning_msgs, 1, 60)
print(head(warning_summary, 10))

cat("\n--- RMSEA Summary ---\n")
RMSEA_summary <- results %>%
  filter(converged == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_RMSEA = mean(rmsea, na.rm=TRUE),
    RMSEA_05_Rate = mean(rmsea < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(RMSEA_summary)
```

#### Corr. Matrix misfit

```{r}
source("functionSource.R")
data <- DGM(timepoints = 30, N = 40000)

fitSRI_free <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm
                   (T = 30, timespan = 3, across_seg_cov = "free"), 
                   data = data$data)
fitSRI_toep <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm
                   (T = 30, timespan = 3, across_seg_cov = "toeplitz"), 
                   data = data$data)

freeCorMat <- lavInspect(fitSRI_free, "cor.lv")
toepCorMat <- lavInspect(fitSRI_toep, "cor.lv")

diffMatrix <- freeCorMat - toepCorMat

heatmap <- diffMatrix[1:20, 1:20] %>% 
  as.table() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  # Adjust size and set color based on intensity for readability
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq), 
                color = abs(Freq) > 0.05), # Logical check for high contrast
            size = 3) + 
  # Use scale_color_manual to switch between black and white text
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "white"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", 
                       high = "red", 
                       mid = "white", 
                       midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Difference") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Latent Correlation Difference: Free vs. Toeplitz",
       subtitle = "Calculated as (Free Matrix - Toeplitz Matrix)",
       x = "Latent Variable",
       y = "Latent Variable")

print(heatmap)
```

### Other DGM's

It would be worth my time to also run some simulations to look at model performance under different DGM's (e.g. a standard RI-CLPM with stable between person trait, unmeasured time-invariant confounding or a CLPM).

Correlation matrix latent variables (kijken naar misfit tussen freely estimated en Toeplitz constrained)

Long format (DSEM)

Attempt at new DGM according to a RI-CLPM

```{r}
library(mvtnorm)

DGM_RICLPM <- function(N = 20000, 
                autocorr_effects = 0.2, 
                timepoints = 100, 
                n_x_confounders = 5, 
                n_y_confounders = 5,
                beta_focal = 0.1,
                beta_covfocal = 0.1,
                beta_covnofocal = 0.01,
                sigma = 0.5,
                # --- NEW PARAMETERS FOR RANDOM INTERCEPTS ---
                ri_var_x = 1.0,  # Variance of RI for X
                ri_var_y = 1.0,  # Variance of RI for Y
                ri_cor = 0.3,    # Correlation between RI_x and RI_y
                seed = 427) 
  {

  # Set seed for reproducibility
  set.seed(seed)
  
  T <- timepoints
  c1 <- n_x_confounders
  c2 <- n_y_confounders
  alpha <- autocorr_effects
  
  # Helper functions for matrix operations
  irow <- function(x) matrix(x, nrow = sqrt(length(x)), byrow = TRUE)
  row <- function(x) as.vector(t(x))
  
  # New objects for the simulation
  ## total number of variables
  v <- c1 + c2 + 2
  
  ## A: Matrix of path coefficients
  A <- matrix(NA, v, v)
  diag(A) <- alpha
  A[lower.tri(A, diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covnofocal 
  A[upper.tri(A, diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covnofocal
  
  c1t <- 3:(2+c1)
  c2t <- (3+c1):v
  A[c1t, 1] <- beta_covfocal
  A[1, c1t] <- beta_covfocal
  A[c2t, 2] <- beta_covfocal
  A[2, c2t] <- beta_covfocal
  A[c1t, c1t][lower.tri(A[c1t, c1t], diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covfocal
  A[c1t, c1t][upper.tri(A[c1t, c1t], diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covfocal
  A[c2t, c2t][lower.tri(A[c2t, c2t], diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covfocal
  A[c2t, c2t][upper.tri(A[c2t, c2t], diag = FALSE)] <- beta_covfocal
  A[1,2] <- beta_focal
  A[2,1] <- beta_focal
  
  ## Check the max eigenvalue (to check stationarity)
  max_eigenvalue <- max(eigen(A)$values)
  if (max_eigenvalue >= 1) {
    warning(paste("Maximum eigenvalue is", round(max_eigenvalue, 4),"- the system may not be stationary"))
  }
  
  ## Sigma: Var-cov matrix of time-specific residuals
  Sigma <- diag(rep(sigma, v))
  
  ## Sigma1: Stationary Var-cov matrix for the first time point
  Sigma1 <- irow(solve(diag(dim(A)[1]^2) - t(A) %x% t(A)) %*% row(Sigma))
  
  ## Mean1: Stationary means for first time point
  Mean1 <- matrix(0, nrow = dim(A)[1], ncol = 1)
  
  # --- Generate Time-Varying Data (CLPM process) ---
  
  # create empty dataframe
  df_within <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = 2*T)
  
  ## Generate the initial values for X and Y and store them in D
  D <- rmvnorm(N, mean = Mean1, Sigma1)
  
  ## Store the initial data from D to df_within
  df_within[, 1] <- D[, 1]
  df_within[, 1+T] <- D[, 2]
  
  ## Update D and df_within till time T
  for (i in 2:T) {
    D <- D %*% t(A) + rmvnorm(N, sigma = Sigma)
    df_within[, i] <- D[, 1]
    df_within[, i+T] <- D[, 2]
  }
  
  # --- Generate Random Intercepts (Time-Invariant Confounders) ---
  
  # Calculate covariance from correlation and variances
  ri_cov <- ri_cor * sqrt(ri_var_x * ri_var_y)
  ri_sigma_mat <- matrix(c(ri_var_x, ri_cov, ri_cov, ri_var_y), nrow = 2)
  
  # Generate N random intercepts
  RIs <- rmvnorm(N, mean = c(0, 0), sigma = ri_sigma_mat)
  colnames(RIs) <- c("RI_x", "RI_y")
  
  # --- Combine Within-Person and Between-Person Components ---
  
  # Create final dataframe
  df_final <- df_within
  colnames(df_final) <- c(paste("x", 1:T, sep = ""), paste("y", 1:T, sep = ""))
  
  # Add RI_x to all X columns (1 to T)
  # Note: R recycles the vector RIs[,1] column-wise, which matches the N rows correctly
  df_final[, 1:T] <- df_final[, 1:T] + RIs[, 1]
  
  # Add RI_y to all Y columns (T+1 to 2T)
  df_final[, (T+1):(2*T)] <- df_final[, (T+1):(2*T)] + RIs[, 2]
  
  # Return results as a list
  return(list(
    data = df_final,
    components = list(
      within = df_within,
      between = RIs
    ),
    parameters = list(
      N = N,
      timepoints = T,
      n_x_confounders = c1,
      n_y_confounders = c2,
      autocorr_effects = alpha,
      beta_focal = beta_focal,
      beta_covfocal = beta_covfocal,
      beta_covnofocal = beta_covnofocal,
      sigma = sigma,
      StatCOVmatrix = Sigma1,
      max_eigenvalue = max_eigenvalue,
      # New parameters
      ri_var_x = ri_var_x,
      ri_var_y = ri_var_y,
      ri_cor = ri_cor
    ),
    coefficient_matrix = A
  ))
}

# Some validation

sim_output <- DGM_RICLPM(N = 100000, timepoints = 50, 
                  autocorr_effects = 0.3, 
                  ri_var_x = 4.5, 
                  ri_var_y = 4.5, 
                  ri_cor = 0.5)

df <- as.data.frame(sim_output$data)

# Visualisation

library(tidyverse)

df_long <- df %>%
  mutate(id = 1:nrow(.)) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>% # Pick 5 people
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("x"), names_to = "time", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("x", "", time)))

ggplot(df_long, aes(x=time, y=value, color=factor(id))) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Visual Check: Do individuals have different stable means?") +
  theme_minimal()

# Quick check

cor_start_end_x <- cor(df$x1, df$x50)

cat("Correlation between X1 and X50 NEW DGM:", round(cor_start_end_x, 3), "\n")

sim_output <- DGM(N = 100000, timepoints = 50, 
                  autocorr_effects = 0.3)

df <- as.data.frame(sim_output$data)

cor_start_end_x <- cor(df$x1, df$x50)

cat("Correlation between X1 and X50 OLD DGM:", round(cor_start_end_x, 3), "\n")
```

Belangrijk om nog te checken, bij lagere RI variances lijkt het model nog wat burn-in nodig te hebben? Uit een snelle brainstorm met Gemini is dit wellicht te wijten aan instabiele analytische schatting van de stationaire covariantie matrix Sigma1? Optie om een kleine burn-in in te bouwen.

#### Initial check

Some initial testing of SRI-CLPM performance on this new DGM.

```{r}
data <- DGM_RICLPM(N = 20000, timepoints = 30)

# RI variances set to 1 by default

fitRICLPM <- sem(generate_riclpm(30), data = data$data)
fitSRICLPM <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(30), data = data$data)

summary(fitRICLPM)
summary(fitSRICLPM)
```

Random intercept variances in the RI-CLPM are around 1.025, which seems to correspond to the actual RI variance of 1 + some extra detected from the time-varying component. At first glance the SRI-CLPM seems to still be able to protect against the influence of confounding, although it seems possible the cross-lagged parameters might be slightly underestimated. A full simulation should clarify this.

```{r}
data <- DGM(N = 60, timepoints = 30)

fit <- sem(generate_segmented_riclpm(T=30, timespan=2), data = data$data)

summary(fit)
lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv")
```
